title: It's Burning, Man
description: It's Burning, Man — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Soldier Kwale

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill 25 Fire Mutant Pincers and 25 Fire Mutant Pukers in Upper Algor's Terror-Dome and Return to Soldier Kwale in Algor's Terror-Dome Base Camp.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Soldier Kwale

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: It's Burning, Man

Zone: Algor's Terror Dome (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill 25 Fire Mutant Pincers and 25 Fire Mutant Pukers in Upper Algor's Terror-Dome and Return to Soldier Kwale in Algor's Terror-Dome Base Camp.

Offer:

We have a serious issue on our hands that needs some attention. The Fire Mutants in Upper Algor's Terror-Dome are embarking on a scorched earth campaign to scour the upper dungeon of resources. Needless to say the the King's Board of Trustees is not pleased with this development.

Get into Algor's Terror-Dome and take out some Mutant Fire Pincers and Pukers to keep them from ruining what could be a very profitable dungeon for us. Be warned, those Fire Mutants are acting really strange out there, so watch yourself.

When you are done return to me, Soldier Kwale, here in the Algor Staging Area.

Turn-in:

How goes the battle against the Fire Mutants? Our reports show that no significant damage has been done to Algor's Terror-Dome... yet.

Objectives:

  • Slain Fire Mutant Pincers
  • Slain Fire Mutant Pukers

Client level range: 10–25
